values.note: No trash pickup and no firewood. Accessible toilets, tables and parking.

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Gardiner Ranger District) campground in the Gallatin Mountains: 17 mi NW of Gardiner on US 89, then 12 mi SW on Tom Miner Rd. Horse corrals and the trailhead for the Gallatin Petrified Forest Trail adjoin the upper end. Elev ~7130 ft. --Claude
